tools.name: list_buying_guides
tools.description: List everything we cover: product categories (with guide URLs, product counts and FAQs) plus our long-form buying guides, each with a one-sentence standalone answer and key takeaways.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Full text of one buying guide by slug: the short answer, key takeaways, every section with its bullets, and the FAQ. Use this to answer 'how do I choose / what size / what should I look for' questions rather than only recommending a product.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search or browse our recommended products. Filter by category slug, maximum price, and/or a free-text query matched against name, brand, award, and use case.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Full editorial record for one product by slug: rating, pros/cons, specs, full review text, review URL, and buy link.

tools.name: recommend_product
tools.description: Recommend the best product for a described use case and optional budget. Returns a top pick with reasoning plus alternatives.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Head-to-head comparison of two or more products by slug.
